# Installation

Regardless of the installation method, `NextPyper` requires `conda` in your PATH, to manage and deploy workflow environments.

::: {.callout-important}

While we finish the Publication process in the official repositories, please install `NextPyper` through pip, using the package release available in [testPyPi](https://test.pypi.org/project/NextPyper/0.1.3/). In other words, in a fresh conda environment:

```bash
pip install -i https://test.pypi.org/simple/ NextPyper==0.1.3
```

:::


## Conda/Mamba and Pip

If you already have [bioconda](https://bioconda.github.io/) set up, you can create a new environment and simply run:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### conda 

```bash
conda install nextpyper
```

### mamba

```bash
mamba install nextpyper
```

### Pip

```bash
pip install nextpyper
```

:::

<!-- ```bash
conda install nextpyper # or mamba
``` -->

## Manual 

You can also install NextPyper manually by cloning the [repository]("https://github.com/M2BL/NextPyper") and installing it locally. We recommend to create a new environment.

```bash
git clone git@github.com:M2BL/NextPyper.git
cd NextPyper
pip install .
```

::: {.callout-tip}
We highly recommend to [setup NextPyper environments](02-env_setup.qmd) after installation to complete the setup.
:::
